title: DiMeLo-cito: a one-tube protocol for mapping protein-DNA interactions reveals CTCF bookmarking in mitosis
authors: Nathan Gamarra; Cy Chittenden; Kousik Sundararajan; Jacob P. Schwartz; Sofia Lundqvist; Denise Robles; Oberon Dixon-Luinenburg; Jeremy Marcus; Annie Maslan; J. Matthew Franklin; Aaron Streets; Aaron F. Straight; Nicolas Altemose
one_liner_zh: 该文开发DiMeLo-cito单管无洗涤方案，利用长读长测序绘制蛋白-DNA互作图谱，并发现CTCF在有丝分裂中的书签结合，但核心是实验方法学改进，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Genome regulation relies on complex and dynamic interactions between DNA and proteins. Recently, powerful methods have emerged that leverage third-generation sequencing to map protein-DNA interactions genome-wide. For example, Directed Methylation with Long-read sequencing (DiMeLo-seq) enables mapping of protein-DNA interactions along long, single chromatin fibers, including in highly repetitive genomic regions. However, DiMeLo-seq involves lossy centrifugation-based wash steps that limit its applicability to many sample types. To address this, we developed DiMeLo-cito, a single-tube, wash-free protocol that maximizes the yield and quality of genomic DNA obtained for long-read sequencing. This protocol enables the interrogation of genome-wide protein binding with as few as 100,000 cells and without the requirement of a nuclear envelope, enabling confident measurement of protein-DNA interactions during mitosis. Using this protocol, we detected strong binding of CTCF to mitotic chromosomes in diploid human cells, in contrast with earlier studies in karyotypically unstable cancer cell lines, suggesting that CTCF “bookmarks” specific sites critical for maintaining genome architecture across cell divisions. By expanding the capabilities of DiMeLo-seq to a broader range of sample types, DiMeLo-cito can provide new insights into genome regulation and organization.
abstract_zh: 基因组调控依赖于DNA与蛋白质之间复杂且动态的相互作用。近年来，涌现出利用第三代测序技术在全基因组范围内绘制蛋白质-DNA相互作用图谱的强大方法。例如，长读长测序定向甲基化（DiMeLo-seq）技术能够在长单染色质纤维上，包括高度重复的基因组区域，绘制蛋白质-DNA相互作用图谱。然而，DiMeLo-seq涉及基于离心的有损洗涤步骤，这限制了其在多种样本类型中的适用性。为解决这一问题，我们开发了DiMeLo-cito，一种单管、无洗涤的流程，可最大化长读长测序所获基因组DNA的产量和质量。该流程仅需10万个细胞即可实现全基因组蛋白质结合的检测，且无需核膜，从而能够在有丝分裂期间可靠测量蛋白质-DNA相互作用。利用此流程，我们在二倍体人类细胞中检测到CTCF与有丝分裂染色体的强结合，这与早期在核型不稳定的癌细胞系中的研究结果形成对比，提示CTCF“标记”了维持基因组结构跨细胞分裂的关键特定位点。通过将DiMeLo-seq的能力扩展到更广泛的样本类型，DiMeLo-cito可为基因组调控与组织提供新的见解。
